name: Kásád (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of red and blue at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Kásád (a shield of blue and yellow with a wagon wheel, a fish and waves, with red and blue mantling) above a yellow scroll inscribed KÁSÁD.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Kásád arms with mantling and scroll
